spec: LEGION-35 primary Dispatch document (dispatch_doc_read issue=LEGION-35): Design, Errors, Acceptance 1-7, Rejected
workflowRecommendation: One implementer, superpowers:executing-plans task by task in $LEGION_WORKSPACE. Task 0 (feasibility probe) runs before anything else; if flock is unreachable from bun:ffi, stop and report to the architect instead of building the rejected pid-file shape. Tasks 2-3 are red-then-green at file granularity (6 of the 12 new tests fail against today's module). Single commit of exactly four files via `jj split` with explicit paths; `.omp/config.yml` (0-byte, OMP-provisioned) stays out.

probe.host: workstation, Bun 1.3.14, glibc 2.39, x86_64, load average ~139 on 32 cores
probe.fdinfoFlagsWithNumeric0o2000000: 02100002 (CLOEXEC set; Bun forwards extra numeric open flags)

childInheritsDescriptor.reason: Bun's spawn closes non-stdio descriptors; the module still sets O_CLOEXEC explicitly

probe.compiledBinary: bun build --compile of an entry importing the module: acquires; second copy exits 1 with the exact 'already running (pid H, lock file X)' message; acquires again after SIGKILL of the holder

evidence.before: today's race test x50 under 32 nice'd busy loops + fsync writer (load ~139): 49 pass, 1 fail — iteration 46: expect(received).toHaveLength(expected) Expected length: 1 Received length: 2 at instance-lock.test.ts:87 (two contenders reproduce on this machine)
evidence.after: rewritten module + full new suite x50 under the same load: 50 pass, 0 fail (128 s)
evidence.redSet: new suite against today's module: 6 pass, 6 fail (release leaves file in place; live-pid-text takeover; three-contender race with inode; waits for unrecorded holder pid; never-recorded holder pid; close-on-exec)
evidence.typeCheck: tsc clean against packages/daemon tsconfig + @types/bun 1.4.2; biome check clean on the three files after --write formatting

concerns: release() must be idempotent: index.ts:667-676 releases via stop() then rethrows into startDaemon's catch (index.ts:210-213), which releases again; a bare closeSync would throw EBADF and replace the probe error (and could close a reused descriptor number)

fs.constants.O_CLOEXEC is undefined under Bun 1.3.14 and Bun's openSync does not set CLOEXEC on its own (fdinfo flags 0100002); the module ORs a numeric per-platform constant and the no-inherit test asserts the bit via /proc/self/fdinfo on Linux
macOS table row (libSystem.B.dylib, __error, EWOULDBLOCK 35, O_CLOEXEC 0x1000000) is unverified on this Linux host — [INFERENCE] from Darwin headers; deployment is glibc Linux everywhere

Everything after `await mkdir` is synchronous, so in-process contenders serialize; the in-process race test is deterministic and no longer exercises the pid re-read loop — two child-process tests with the fixture's --raw mode cover it
Race test now runs three contenders permanently, with inode assertions after every round and every release

New message texts: 'Legion daemon already running for this project (holder pid not recorded yet, lock file X)'; 'flock(X) failed with errno N'; 'Cannot load flock and from : '; 'Legion daemon instance lock needs flock(2) from the C library, and no C library name is known for platform

'
Re-read bound 20 x 25 ms = 500 ms; the 'never records its pid' test therefore takes ~0.5 s
The working copy carries a 0-byte OMP-provisioned .omp/config.yml (also present in other issue workspaces); the commit step names files explicitly so it does not land
